findings.title: Tick mutability conflicts with the architecture’s state contract
findings.description: The architecture describes the engine as stateless between ticks and says the tick returns updated state (architecture §Envisioned State, lines 62–70). This design specifies `tick() -> None` and mutates the input state in place. Align the contract with the architecture, or explicitly reconcile the intended mutation semantics.

findings.title: The slice omits the parent’s scale target
findings.description: This slice defines the hot path and spatial-query implementation, but does not restate the architecture’s target of supporting tens of thousands of agents at full fidelity on one CPU process (architecture lines 33, 87). Its “hundreds-of-agents scale” statement (line 173) describes the brute-force implementation, not the engine’s target. State the applicable target and clarify that brute force is only the initial reference implementation.
